alt: A living room from the doorway shown five times with different design languages: Moroccan with terracotta walls and brass details, Scandinavian with pale oak and cream linen, Art Deco with emerald and sapphire velvet, wabi-sabi with raw plaster and undyed linen, Parisian with herringbone flooring and rose velvet.
text:
one room, five design languages.

sofa never moved. window stayed put.
only what everything says changed.

the second frame is the one i keep walking back to.

#interiors #designlanguage #spacemaking #interiornarrative
